Shreya Naidu
Digital Marketing Manager | Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra
shreya.naidu594@example.com | +91 9835721151

Strategic digital marketer and platform developer who combines data-driven SEM and paid media expertise with hands-on automation and low-code development. Comfortable working cross-functionally to drive acquisition, optimize spend, and automate processes that reduce campaign cycle time. Notice period: 30 days.

Experience

Saffron Bank — Jun 2025 - Present
Digital Marketing Manager (Hybrid)
- Launched and optimized Google Ads and SEM campaigns that increased qualified lead volume by 42% while lowering cost-per-acquisition 28% within the first four months using structured keyword testing and bid strategy refinements. (SEM, Google Ads)
- Designed and executed Social Media Marketing programs across LinkedIn and Instagram that grew engagement rate from 1.1% to 3.8% and contributed a 25% uplift in pipeline-sourced meetings quarter-over-quarter. (Social Media Marketing)
- Implemented SEO-driven content calendar and technical fixes that improved organic landing page traffic by 65% and boosted three priority pages into top-5 SERP positions for target keywords. (SEO)
- Introduced Git-based versioning for creative assets and campaign templates to standardize releases and cut creative QA time by 30%. (Git, Agile)

Wipro — Aug 2022 - May 2025
Power Platform Developer (Remote)
- Built Power Automate flows and Power Platform solutions that automated client onboarding steps, reducing manual processing time from 6 hours to 45 minutes per case and decreasing errors by 82%. (Power Automate)
- Developed Copilot Studio integrations and templated prompts to assist analysts in generating standardized reports, improving report turnaround by 60% and enabling faster decision cycles. (Copilot Studio)
- Collaborated in Agile sprints with marketing and operations teams to prototype connectors between CRM and analytics tools, increasing data availability for campaign attribution and enabling more granular SEM budget allocation. (Agile, Power Automate)
- Maintained solution source control and CI handoffs using Git, ensuring faster rollbacks and consistent deployment of automation across environments. (Git)

Projects
- Campaign Automation Toolkit — Created a set of reusable Power Automate templates and scripts to auto-populate campaign briefs, schedule ads, and export weekly performance snapshots; cut campaign setup time by 50%.
- Organic Growth Playbook — Compiled SEO and content best-practices for financial services, enabling SEO-driven landing page launches that averaged 40% higher conversion rates than prior templates.
